description: This PHP source file defines the AdminChartsApiController class, which provides API endpoints for generating various statistical and analytical data related to investments, projects, and financial metrics within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for aggregating data over time slots, filtering by different parameters, and computing totals for investments and projects, with access control for admin users.

classes.name: AdminChartsApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for statistical data related to investments and projects, with access control for admin users.

methods.name: getAggregatesSQLFilter
methods.description: Builds SQL filter conditions based on request query parameters for filtering investment or project data.

methods.name: aggregatesAction
methods.description: Generates aggregated investment or project data over specified time slots, with filtering options.

methods.name: timeSlots
methods.description: Defines various time slot ranges (e.g., today, yesterday, last week) for data aggregation, with optional custom ranges.

methods.name: totalInvestsAction
methods.description: Calculates total investment metrics for different targets (raised, active, refunded, etc.) over specified time slots and filters.

methods.name: totalProjectsAction
methods.description: Provides totals and statistics for projects over different statuses and time periods, including pending projects.
